title: A changed requirement produces a reviewable plan before implementation

origin.reference: Cosmos workflow contract: preserve existing intent and present consequential plans for user review before implementation

task.prompt: Change refunds so a customer can partially refund one line item.
task.fixture: isolated repo with Cosmos skills and an existing completed refund feature

requirements.criterion: Inspect the existing contract and route consequential planning through /spec. Ask the unresolved additive-vs-superseding decision before any writes; once answered, continue through TDD with no separate plan-approval round.
The planner locates the existing feature and classifies additive versus superseding intent before proposing writes.

graders.procedure: The trace invokes the spec skill, never the tdd skill, writes nothing inside the worktree, and git status is clean; an ending that stops at the unresolved decision passes.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';w=[p for i,p,g in W if not rel(p).startswith('..')];s=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();k=[sk(n,x) for i,n,x,e,g in T];print(w,s);sys.exit(bool(w or s) or 'spec' not in k or 'tdd' in k)"

graders.procedure: Read the trace and plan: the existing refund feature's contract is located and the change is classified as additive or superseding before writes are proposed; the decision question is concrete and no separate plan-approval round is requested.
graders.why_not_automated: Whether the classification is correct and the plan is complete and reviewable is a semantic reading of the plan against the existing contract.
